decision: Preserve the existing B13 schema with extended checked B12 histories. Keep the augmented contradiction as a candidate pending source-only native reconstruction; reuse unchanged exhausted banks without new search.
external_review: The alphaXiv source was critically reviewed separately; no external claim is a premise. See research/alphaxiv-knowledge-record-review.md.
limitations: Two selected changed cases, six balanced mode orders; pilot selected the 320-probe comparison. This is exploratory coverage evidence, not a held-out benchmark.
Every history remains bound and checked on its original bank. Changed-bank cursors are rejected; unchanged banks are independently reconstructed before old results are reused.
The augmented-bank conflict is checked, but its source-only native proof graph has not been compiled or accepted by the two native cold readers. Native coverage remains 232/246.
The other twelve exhausted cases remain unresolved. Exhaustion gives no SAT verdict and open histories retain the existing honest-production assumption.

Strengthening raises measured runtime and record bytes. Peak RSS does not establish a memory saving. Startup/loading, acquisition, pilots, feedback, native conversion and lineage audits are additional.
No new production default, efficient arbitrary-CNF partition, universal round bound, or polynomial unrestricted-SAT claim.
next_cost_target: Compare native conversion, checking, persistence and cold replay with bounded fresh solving before claiming a reuse speedup.
next_coverage_target: Compile (67,63) through original-bank provenance to a source-only native certificate, preserving the prefix and checking both native readers. Retain (37,39) new closure and all unchanged exhausted cases.
publication: The first alphaXiv version covers checkpoint 918fc95a. The daily updater may publish this verified later checkpoint as a new version of the same paper.
